title: What is Salah?
intro: Salah is how we talk to Allah – five times every day.

learn.html: Salah (prayer) is the second pillar of Islam. In Salah we stand before Allah, praise Him, thank Him and ask Him for help. It is the highest way of showing that we obey and thank Allah.

learn.title: 🕐 Five times a day
learn.html: Every day a Muslim prays five prayers: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha. Each one has its own time.

learn.title: 💚 Why do we pray?
learn.html: We pray to come closer to Allah and to earn His pleasure. Salah keeps us away from bad deeds, makes our heart calm and teaches us to be clean and on time.
Before Salah we hear the adhan – the call to prayer. It tells everyone: it is time to pray! Learn the dua we say after it: Dua after the Adhan.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Salah is the second pillar of Islam. We pray five times every day.
